decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (12020/001 & 002, received on 02/04/2012 and  Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment Statement and EA Flood Matrix, received on 12/04/2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - 4	The habitable room hereby permitted by conversion of the garage shall not be occupied at any other time other than for purposes ancillary to residential use of the dwelling known as 12 Kinnaird Avenue, Chiswick.
description: Conversion of garage into habitable room.
